analysis_addendum.scope: Assistant-development analysis addendum recorded before any neural/certificate external-stress outcomes; not student preregistration
analysis_addendum.change: Add explicitly limited fixed-batch uncertainty alongside the already frozen conditional generated-draw summaries. Preserve all selected models, checkpoints, preprocessing, acquisition, and source-domain scales.
analysis_addendum.unit: One original generated velocity model, retaining all four source/frequency blocks; each family/checkpoint reported separately
analysis_addendum.finite_batch_method: Conservative exact hypergeometric CDF inversion: largest feasible K with Pr(X <= observed_failures | N=500, K, n=100) >= 0.05
analysis_addendum.finite_batch_assumptions: Uniform sampling of 100 original indices without replacement from the named fixed 500-model batch; evaluation choices and every model outcome fixed. No IID geological or real-site assumption is used for this fixed-batch result.
analysis_addendum.finite_batch_scope: Only the named batch's failure fraction. No generalization to another batch, family, environment, real site, field data, or the official OpenFWI seismic benchmark.
analysis_addendum.duplicate_handling: Conservatively withhold all intervals if within-batch or cross-family raw duplicate clusters are found; keep every selected model and block without resampling/discarding. Do not collapse duplicates and then claim a simple uniform 100-of-500 cluster sample.
analysis_addendum.conditional_generated_draw_summaries: Existing binomial and whole-model bootstrap summaries additionally assume independent generated-model draws. This is not verified real-site independence and is not a conformal OOD coverage guarantee.
analysis_addendum.multiplicity: Individual one-sided bounds and descriptive bootstrap intervals; no simultaneous guarantee across groups or outcomes
analysis_addendum.calibration: No fitting or recalibration. Existing source-domain calibrated gate outcomes remain descriptive OOD stress results with no nominal conformal coverage claim.

offline_evaluation_costs.scope: Offline validation work, including truth synthesis, shared exact gradients, stability maps and derivative checks. Not an online inversion cost or acceleration measurement.

interpretation_limits: New assistant-development external stress study, not student preregistration or an official OpenFWI seismic benchmark.
Synthetic observations regenerated after resizing two author-provided generated velocity batches; no field data or original seismic records.
Both frozen checkpoints and every selected model/block are reported without training, tuning, recalibration, or model selection.
Source-calibrated OOD coverage and acceptance are descriptive; nominal conformal coverage and exchangeability do not apply.
The original generated model is the statistical unit; four correlated blocks are never four independent models.
Fixed-batch hypergeometric bounds cover only each named 500-model batch under uniform sampling without replacement; no inference to other batches, sites, or families.
Binomial/bootstrap intervals additionally require an independent generated-model draw assumption that is not verified real-site independence.
Families and checkpoints remain separate; intervals are not simultaneous across reported groups/outcomes.
Ordinary numerical discrete bounds do not formally enclose roundoff; direction signs are not finite-step, adaptive-path, or trajectory guarantees.

Angles and strict directional signs can be ill-conditioned for near-stationary models; raw exact/neural objectives and gradient norms are retained, with no post-hoc filtering or sign-threshold changes.
